environment.runtime: x64 Windows console in a Hyper-V-isolated Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 container
environment.candidate: GNU-target x64 Rust build running in the same container
environment.fixtures: Generated regular files and nested directories, including a hidden file and controlled NTFS modification dates

layout.frame: Cyan panel, black inset double border, dark gray close marker, centered directory path, and a black shadow
layout.table: Name column with a 12-cell minimum, size or directory marker, four DOS attributes, date, and time
layout.selection: White on black, filling the selected table row
layout.mask: Centered footer label and a nested gray dialog with cyan shaded input

paired_checks.comparison: The tested region covers the dialog body, borders, close marker and right shadow. The comparator normalizes the terminal's default black. It compares the filter both on opening and on reopening.
paired_checks.coverage: Open F9, move selection, traverse into and out of a directory, dismiss and restore selection, toggle hidden files, sort by name, reverse, apply a wildcard and dismiss the mask

limits: One Windows time zone. The paired frames exclude initial startup, other sort modes, mouse gestures, file history, advanced masks, and the text of contextual Help.
